label: Board Legal & Regulatory Update
description: Compiles a concise monthly or quarterly legal/regulatory update for board and senior management. Synthesizes developments across relevant regulatory areas into actionable board-level briefing.

claudeKnowledge.description: Current regulatory developments, enforcement actions, supervisory priorities

guidedInputs.label: Reporting Period
guidedInputs.description: The period covered by this legal/regulatory update.

guidedInputs.label: Audience
guidedInputs.description: Who is the primary audience for this update?

guidedInputs.label: Topics to Include
guidedInputs.description: Which regulatory areas should be covered?

guidedInputs.label: Key Developments to Highlight
guidedInputs.description: Paste or describe the key regulatory developments from the period. Upload documents via the file uploader.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. EBA published final guidelines on AML/CFT governance (January 2025). EC launched consultation on PSD3 Level 2 measures. AMLA published draft RTS on UBO verification. Swedish FI imposed €12M fine on bank for AML failures...

guidedInputs.label: Internal Compliance Matters
guidedInputs.description: Any internal developments, supervisory interactions, or compliance incidents to include.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Annual MLRO report submitted to board this month. Regulatory examination scheduled for Q2. Training completion at 91% — below 95% target. One SAR filed during the period...
